items.title: Curtis Fuller — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: You saw “Wolf” I’m sure you did. It was with Jack Nicholson. Ken Kimery: Oh yeah.

When he went around the horses and all that he goes, “Oh, shit!” (Laughs) Somebody said---But I gave them a (imitates himself playing) and the animals went wild. Grady had, on the bus, he had, “Yeah, every time Fuller picked up the trombone all the animals went nuts.” But, the point being is that music can reach the savage beast and whatever.
